info.name: Arihant Trading Corporation BOS - Complete API & Edge Cases Collection
info.description:
Exhaustive, production-grade Postman collection covering all BOS modules defined in the Arihant BOS Scope Blueprint.

Features:
- Complete lifecycle covering both happy paths and closing transitions.
- Automatic token capture and variable chaining for Postman Collection Runner.
- Comprehensive 'Edge Cases, RBAC Denials & Validations' test suite.
- Exact field names matching NestJS DTOs and PostgreSQL schema.
